import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 8;
    static final int SZ = 1048576 + 5;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a + b;
        if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a - b;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int multiply(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % MOD);
    }

    static void update(int[] arr, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            arr[i] = add_mod(arr[i], y);
        }
    }

    static int power_mod(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        int b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) result = multiply(result, b);
            b = multiply(b, b);
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int n;
    static int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int inv100;
    static int[][] g = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int[] p = new int[SZ];
    static int[][][] num = new int[7][7][7];
    static int total_mask;
    static int answer;
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[7];

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] perm = {1, 2, 3};
        int[] order = {x, y, z};
        do {
            boolean valid = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                if (g[perm[i]][order[i]] == 0) {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (valid) return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(perm));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr) {
        int i = arr.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = arr.length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;
        swap(arr, i, j);
        reverse(arr, i + 1, arr.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(arr, start++, end--);
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(int current, int x, int y) {
        if (current == 0) return;
        if (x == 4) {
            Arrays.fill(used, true);
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) {
                            int X = -1, Y = -1, Z = -1;
                            used[i] = false; used[j] = false; used[k] = false;
                            for (int l = 1; l <= 6; l++) {
                                if (!used[l]) continue;
                                if (X == -1) X = l;
                                else if (Y == -1) Y = l;
                                else Z = l;
                            }
                            used[i] = true; used[j] = true; used[k] = true;
                            if (Z == -1) continue;
                            state |= num[X][Y][Z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            update(p, new int[]{state});
            return;
        }
        g[x][y] = 1;
        int next_val = multiply(current, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) dfs1(next_val, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(next_val, x, y + 1);
        g[x][y] = 0;
        int next_val_dec = multiply(current, sub_mod(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) dfs1(next_val_dec, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(next_val_dec, x, y + 1);
    }

    static void dfs2(int current, int x, int y) {
        if (current == 0) return;
        if (x == 7) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) state |= num[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            update(new int[]{answer}, multiply(current, p[total_mask ^ state]));
            return;
        }
        g[x - 3][y] = 1;
        int next_val = multiply(current, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) dfs2(next_val, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(next_val, x, y + 1);
        g[x - 3][y] = 0;
        int next_val_dec = multiply(current, sub_mod(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) dfs2(next_val_dec, x + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(next_val_dec, x, y + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        inv100 = power_mod(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = multiply(sc.nextInt(), inv100);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    num[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt;
                    cnt++;
                }
            }
        }
        total_mask = (1 << cnt) - 1;
        Arrays.fill(p, 0);
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << cnt); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    p[i] = add_mod(p[i], p[i ^ (1 << j)]);
                }
            }
        }
        answer = 0;
        dfs2(1, 4, 1);
        answer = sub_mod(1, answer);
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
